_comment: T166 — the chart dialect's directive vocabulary, in ONE place. The engine (core/internal/chartpdf) and the editor's Chart format help (web/studio) are each pinned to this file by a test, because a hand-maintained list mirroring a set defined in another language is exactly the shape that goes stale silently. Add a directive here in the same commit that adds it to the engine.

header.what: shrink the type to keep the chart on one page
how many columns the body is set in
